ast.scope: selected source syntax; macros opaque, no expansion/resolution/type inference

obernants.scope: U contains finite normal helper-call traces with fixed world/options, valid indices and nonoverflowing counters. Candidate inner bound on U minus actual R: reuse of Empty; evaluation/observation with zero passes; or work counters not summing to P*E. Source-derived, not a proved full complement.

B(y) contains all initial weights, ordered exercises, pass counts and evaluator outcomes whose trace yields observed final weights/work counts y. It preserves ambiguity; counts cannot recover a unique lesson or initial state.
For fixed ask, w~v iff their VIAS.len()*NF block is equal. A Scored memo accepts its stored block class. Equal answers additionally assume stable world/options and evaluator dependence on that block.
For valid right index, Inert iff !understood OR count.is_some OR correct option has no best support. Correctness alone does not imply inertness.

An understood, non-count answer with supported correct option remains Scored even when currently correct. Changing its block can change the winner; the stored correct choice must not bypass invalidation.
The stored block precedes learn_answer. A later lookup is valid exactly when its current block equals that snapshot; a changing update invalidates its own memo.
The target is equality of every ordered weight vector between cached and recomputed paths, under the shared evaluator contract. This is stronger than equal final scores.
At normal return, e+r+i=P*E with all counters nonnegative and nonoverflowing. Many branch decompositions share this total; it cannot identify reused questions.
Within learn_lesson_with, P=0 returns default work before preparation/evaluation/observation/timing. Outer learn_lesson still calls enabled first, so environment initialization is not excluded.
With E=0 and P>0, counters and observer/evaluator calls are zero, but enabled timing may append P durations. Zero counters do not reconstruct P.
Each call creates Empty memos; inert conclusions from earlier facts cannot survive a new call. First pass evaluates every exercise in a nonempty call.
Permutation may change learned trajectories. Cached execution must match recomputation for that same order; order invariance is not claimed.
Seed=((lesson.n as u64)<<20) OR ((index as u64)<<1). Without range bounds the encoding is noninjective through bit overlap/truncation; fixed options and seed do not identify a unique lesson.
OnceLock reads MOVA_LEARN_REUSE once: exact 0 disables, other values or lookup error enable. Later changes cannot replace that decision; direct helper calls bypass it.
pass_ns records per-pass elapsed time when enabled, not separate evaluator costs. u128 nanoseconds are cast to u64; no unbounded-duration preservation is asserted.
LearnWork::add sums counts and zero-padded pass vectors; the result loses partition attribution. Preimages include all compatible summand pairs, assuming no overflow.

At most E memo slots exist. Scored stores a block and Answer; prepared options also consume space. Memo/preparation storage is O(E*(W+Answer footprint+option footprint)); enabled pass timing adds O(P) retained memory. This is not O(W) total.
Model preparation plus validity probes, evaluated*C_eval and reached update costs. Reuse removes evaluations while adding comparisons/snapshots; lower evaluated count alone is not a speedup.
Block equality is insufficient if an evaluator reads changing world/options or other weight blocks. Such behavior is excluded by lifetime/dependency assumptions, not detected by Memo::valid.
Skipping learn_answer for Inert is equivalent only if unsupported/count/no-correct-support answers cannot update relevant reference state. This is a learner dependency obligation.
